annotations.title: Get delivery options for a city

description: Delivery to a city as the Trailhead Supply checkout offers it right now: the delivery zone the city belongs to (matched_city=false means the catch-all rate applies), each courier option with its fee in USD and delivery time, the order total above which delivery is free, and whether same-day delivery is available today, with the reason when it is not. With a product (and quantity) same-day can account for that product's stock; with a basket subtotal each fee is the one that basket would pay.

city.description: The delivery city as the shopper writes it.

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

product.description: The product: its public_id from an earlier answer, its page URL or slug on the store's website, or the manufacturer model number.

subtotal.description: Basket subtotal in USD: each fee is then what that basket pays.

name: get_delivery_options

answer_type.description: What this answer is, for rendering.

free_above.description: Order total in USD from which delivery is free; null when there is none.

fee.description: USD; 0 is free, null when not known up front.

reason.description: Why same-day is not available, in the answer language.

stock_checked.description: True when the product's stock near the city was checked.

truncated.description: Present and true only when the answer outgrew the size budget and its last list items were left out; ask narrower to see them.

matched_city.description: False: the city is not listed and the catch-all zone applies.

title: Get delivery options for a city
